newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria offers 100,000 tonnes of wheat for sale.
newsitem.headline: Syria offers 100,000 tonnes of wheat for sale.

text.p: Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) has offered 100,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for sale, a company spokesman said on Monday.
He said an international call for prices setting October 29 as final date to receive price offers had already been issued. Confirmation would be made on October 30.
The amount from the 1995 crops would be ready for shipment in December, he added.
This tender replaces a tender announced on September 11 of 100,000 tonnes which was cancelled.
The spokesman said the GECPT had cancelled the tender because price offers were not appropriate.
